RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful appointee are women, meaning sex was not a barrier to appointment and cannot support a claim of sex discrimination. An all-female panel selecting a female candidate is neither unusual nor evidence of improper bias. 

Raising the panel’s gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation within the civil service. Instead, send a polite follow-up request regarding your written feedback; two weeks is a standard administrative delay. Once you receive the assessment, review the outcome based on objective competencies and project experience (such as international project leadership), keeping any further inquiries focused strictly on procedural fairness and merit.
